extract_patches_from_tensor: extract non-overlapping patches from a PyTorch tensor of shape (B, H, W, C) using a given patch size
merge_patches_back_to_tensor: merge a sequence of patches back into a reconstructed image tensor of shape (B, H, W, C)
create_patchify_tokenizer: create a PatchifyTokenizer instance with a specified patch size for encoding and decoding image trajectories
encode_trajectory_to_patches: encode a 5D trajectory tensor (B, L, H, W, C) of pixel values into normalized patches using PatchifyTokenizer
decode_patches_to_trajectory: decode a 4D patch tensor (B, L, P, C) back into a denormalized clamped trajectory tensor using PatchifyTokenizer
